name: Ledzbika
slug: Elderly half-elf spirit pulled from rest, trying to return to his abode.
description: Ledzbika is an elderly half-elf spirit among those drawn to the active staff. Divine Sense reads him as undead: a spectral spirit made physical, with no subtype. He is half-formed but physically grabbable. He says his peace was disturbed, that the party pulled them from life and from rest, and that the one who shed light on them burned them. He is trying to return to his abode, whose location he does not give. He names Claire Belle as the woman next door who stole from him and his family, says his silver is under the floorboards, blames her for his children starving, and says he is stuck and must get back to find her. Later repetitions of his name are also heard as Bannaby, Burton, Barnaby, and Carnaby.

log.summary: Ord grabs Ledzbika as one of the last two spirits after four others are already sucked in. Pulled toward Sylan, he is kept back by Ord's grip. He demands release, gives his name as Ledzbika and says he already gave it, and insists he is trying to return to his abode rather than go to Sylan. He names Claire Belle as the neighbor who stole from him and his family, says his silver is under the floorboards, and blames her for his children starving. When released he dematerializes, reaches toward New Navel, and snaps away. A separate raspy voice may be his or another spirit's.
